purpose: Indicate that work is in progress.
avoid: Animation does not communicate purpose or completion by itself.
basis: Native source page 1196:1174 (Spinner), observed anatomy and examples.
profileRationale: Meaningful native content or a content container in its default source mode. Interactive descendants/native render overrides keep their own native or component contracts; no decorative fallback or invented selection API.
contentAlternative: The actual wrapper has role=status and default aria-label=Loading; this reference supplies a task-specific localized name. Animation is supplementary.
updatesAndDescendants: Spinner renders the selected icon with an animation class; it does not start tasks, calculate progress or determine completion. The task owner removes/replaces the status on completion/failure. Reduced motion may stop rotation while keeping the accessible status.
referenceDecision: The task-specific label and reduced-motion policy are explicit usage decisions. The icon-family picker on the registry website is outside the component API.

visualContract.layoutPolicy: The actual source indicator is a role=status SVG with a default Loading name. Reference usage supplies the task-specific Loading contacts name. The default16px size and12/20/24px source specimens map to explicit caller classes, not an invented public size prop. The source icon adapter chooses a vendor glyph; canonical SVG is a semantic icon projection, not a claim that native path bytes match all vendors. A chosen1s rotation expresses animate-spin; reduced-motion removes movement while preserving named status.
